items.description: Bhasaka Technologies is a Hyderabad-based Adobe Silver Solution Partner, founded in 2018, that works exclusively on Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, AEP, Workfront and Adobe Commerce) for 50+ enterprise clients across media, retail and financial services. As an AEM Developer here, I build and maintain enterprise AEM Sites and Assets solutions on both AEM 6.5 and AEM as a Cloud Service. My day-to-day work covers custom components with Sling Models, HTL and OSGi services, along with workflows, Content/Experience Fragments and DAM customisations. I also build integrations through REST and GraphQL APIs and ship code through Maven, Jenkins and Cloud Manager pipelines.
